2021 Q1.gq: We are raising our forecast for capital investment from our previous range of $350 million to $400 million for 2021 to $450 million to $550 million, including the planned capacity expansion investments as announced on April 29.

2021 Q2.gq: Finally regarding capital investments, we maintained our forecast for a range of $450 million to $550 million including the planned capacity expansion investments as announced on April 29 of this year.

2023 Q2.bq: In line with our expectations, sales in the second quarter were relatively low, while we came in at the high end of our communicated range.

2024 Q2.bq: Q2 sales were above our guidance of approximately $100 million primarily due to stronger than expected sales in the United States.

2024 Q3.gq: For R&D, we are lowering our full year estimate to $4.6 billion to $4.7 billion from our previous guidance of $4.8 billion.

2025 Q2.bq: While product sales declined 38% compared to the second quarter of 2024, sales were slightly above our expectations due to a stronger-than-expected U.S. spring booster season.

2025 Q3.gq: For international markets, we now expect revenue to be between $300 million and $400 million in the fourth quarter, bringing the full year to $600 million to $700 million versus our previous guidance of $500 million to $700 million.

2026 Q1.bq: For the first quarter, total revenue was $400 million, coming in above our guidance and represents a $300 million increase versus the prior year.

2026 Q2.bq: For the second quarter, total revenue was $145 million, above the guidance range we provided on the first quarter call.
